seo.title: AllBonus — Referral & Sign-up Bonus Apps in India
seo.description: Download popular Indian apps like Paytm, PhonePe, Google Pay, CRED and Groww through referral links and claim the sign-up bonus. Simple steps, updated offers.

promo_text: AllBonus brings together the official referral and sign-up offers from India's most popular payment, investing, bill-payment and food-delivery apps — Paytm, PhonePe, Google Pay, CRED, Groww, Upstox, Swiggy and more. Pick an app, sign up through our link and claim your welcome reward.

sections.title: Featured Referral Apps
sections.body:
AllBonus lists only legal, well-known apps from the official Play Store and App Store.

### Paytm — payments, recharges and bills
Use UPI, pay bills, recharge your phone and book tickets. New users can unlock a welcome offer after their first qualifying payment.

### Google Pay — UPI payments
Google's UPI app for paying friends and shops. Join through an invite link and make your first payment within 28 days to get the invite reward.

### Groww — stocks and mutual funds
Open a free demat account with PAN and Aadhaar. Under Groww's referral programme, both you and your referrer get a cash reward once your account is activated.

sections.title: Tips to get your bonus
sections.body:
- **Install through our link:** referral tracking only works if you install from the referral link or enter the code.
- **Complete KYC:** most apps credit the reward only after verification.
- **Do the qualifying action:** usually a first UPI payment, bill payment or account opening.
- **One account per person:** duplicate accounts usually lose the bonus.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.body: AllBonus is an independent platform. We don't own or operate any app listed here. Reward amounts and rules are set by each app and may change without notice — always check the terms inside the app. We never ask for your OTP, PIN or card details.

sections.title: About AllBonus
sections.body: AllBonus was started to make referral offers simple. Instead of searching across many sites, you'll find each app's current offer, the exact steps to claim it and the terms in one place. We list only legal apps — no betting, gambling or real-money games.

items.question: Why didn't I receive my bonus?
items.answer: Most bonuses need a qualifying action such as KYC or a first transaction, and are for new users only. Check the terms on the app's page.
